test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is __**façade**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **noun **is a word (other than a pronoun) that is used to name a specific one of these or to identify any of a class of people, places, or things (proper noun).
 
• The word **façade **is a noun which means the main entrance of a building, which looks out onto a street or other public area.
 
• *Example *: The façade of the home is half-timbere.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Architecture **is a noun which means design and construction of structures as an art or discipline..

*Example *: There is an **architecture **school near my home.

 
• The word **Tunnel **is a noun which** **means an artificial underground passage, especially one that is dug through a hill or beneath a structure, road, or river.

*Example *: Atal **tunnel **is the longest tunnel.

 
• The word **Vent **means an opening that let restricted space air, gas, or liquid to enter or exit.

*Example *: The AC **vent **is not functioning properly.
